label: Dual-Contrast Picking Tray Set
description: A shallow, non-reflective tray used to spread out micro-fossil concentrate for visual sorting under a microscope.

components.function: Black side for light-colored fossils (calcite/quartz); White side for dark, mineralized fossils.
Used to pick up fragments less than 1mm in size without crushing them.
Moistened slightly to 'tack' and lift the smallest teeth via surface tension.

game_mechanics.contrast_toggle: Player must flip the tray insert to see 'stealth' fossils that match the current background color.
game_mechanics.sorting_mini_game: A timed challenge to pick 'X' number of mammal teeth out of a pile of 'Y' gravel. Success depends on zoom level and steady hand.
